subject: Re: Pricing & token volumes — confirm budget owner

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: pricing & token volumes (post-call)

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our side: 

- Usage profile you shared: 2 main workloads — real-time chat assistant (avg 40 tokens/request, ~1.5M requests/month) and background summarization/batch jobs (avg 2k tokens/request, ~25k requests/month).
- You estimated ~200M–300M tokens/month initially, with potential to grow to ~1B tokens within 9–12 months depending on adoption.

As a next step, to qualify pricing I want to confirm two things: 
1) Economic buyer / budget owner at Finex for this initiative (name & finance contact).
2) Target unit economics you need to see (e.g., target $/1M tokens or target monthly spend range).

Attached is a lightweight usage worksheet we asked you to fill in — helps lock in a recommended configuration and ballpark units. I attached "Finex-MA-usage-estimates.xlsx" for your convenience.

If you can confirm the budget owner and give a target $/1M tokens range (or monthly $ target), I’ll put together a tailored pricing example (hosted vs dedicated) and a short economic model showing projected monthly cost at current and 3x scale.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

(415) 555-0192

Thanks Marissa — good summary. Priya (cc) is our Head of Finance; she owns the budget sign-off for platform investments. I’m the ML Platform lead and will own technical fit and rollout.

Quick answers:
- We filled the worksheet and attached it in my reply (sent separately) — ballpark numbers match your summary: ~250M tokens/month to start, projected ~800–1,000M in 9–12 months if adoption goes well.
- For procurement to move quickly, Priya typically wants a target of $X–$Y per 1M tokens (feel free to set a recommended band). As a sanity check, can you propose a target $/1M tokens for hosted vs dedicated? We’re looking for comparables since we need to model spend into next year.

Also: who at Redwood should Priya engage with for a formal quote and contract terms (SLA/enterprise add-ons)?

Appreciate the worksheet — will get Priya to confirm budget owner formally.

—Alex

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@finex-payments.com>, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2026 11:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: pricing & token volumes (post-call)

Hi Alex / Priya — great, thanks for the quick context. Short answers to your asks and a proposed next step: 

1) Unit economics (ballpark ranges, $ per 1M tokens):
   - Hosted (multitenant) typical list: $60–$90 per 1M tokens for mixed chat + long-context workloads at your scale (volume discounts at >500M/mo).
   - Dedicated (reserved capacity) indicative: $25–$45 per 1M tokens equivalent depending on committed token volume, chosen GPU profile, and q4/quantization settings.
   - If you anticipate hitting ~800M–1B tokens/mo within 9–12 months, a dedicated commitment typically gives the best unit economics and predictable spend.

2) What I’ll deliver next: a two-page pricing memo showing: current month cost (hosted), committed-dedicated example at 12mo commit, and a break-even point versus hosted for your profile. I’ll include assumptions (batching, KV cache hit estimates, quantization).

3) Who to engage: For formal quote + contract, Priya can engage our Sales Ops & Legal via myself — I’ll loop in Rishi (Sales Ops) who coordinates quotes and typical enterprise terms. 

Could you confirm:
- Priya, are you the finance approval for the initial commit or is there another procurement/finance person we should include?
- Preferred budget range for initial 12-mo commit (e.g., $150k–$300k / $300k–$600k / >$600k) — this helps me tailor the committed pricing tiers.

I’ve attached the usage worksheet you filled and will draft the memo once I have your budget range and confirmation of the finance approver.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: Finex-MA-usage-estimates.xlsx (re-attached)

Can you confirm which of these three buckets we should model for procurement: 
- $150k–$300k initial commit
- $300k–$600k initial commit
- >$600k initial commit

Also, is procurement the same contact as the budget approver, or do you need me to route through legal/procurement separately?

Thanks — Alex
